ns2:course.label: Advanced Studies in HDFS
ns2:course.description: Library or experimental research on specific problems of limited scope. May be taken in addition to 32 hours required for a master's degree by students who do not write a thesis. For non-thesis students only. May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 4 hours.
